notes:
Duplicate of the Hyksos: Cliopatria's rows 'Fifteenth Dynasty of Egypt' (Q728479) and 'Hyksos' (another Wikidata id) are the same Avaris kingdom; the Hyksos dossier (another batch) already uses this row's shape as its Egyptian core and asks the orchestrator to merge or demote one. This dossier keeps the dynasty-level view (Egypt only; the Levant is the Hyksos dossier's Sharuhen). Colour: one of the two must be hidden or merged.
Cliopatria's 'Sixteenth Dynasty' shape (eastern Delta, 30.7-32.8 E, 29.2-31.5 N) sits on Avaris itself; with this row's western-Delta-and-Middle-Egypt shape it makes the whole Hyksos Egypt. The 16th Dynasty dossier treats the 16th as Theban per its page; this dossier adds Avaris to the 15th's shape.
Disagreements: end of the dynasty c. 1550 (infobox) versus Ahmose I's own four reign dates (1570-1546 ... 1539-1514) and his conquest 'by the 18th or 19th year'; the Seventeenth Dynasty page has the capture of Memphis in 1559 BC and then of Hutwaret by naval support, before Kamose's year 3 (1553), which reached only Cusae; not drawn. The 15th Dynasty page says the whole of Egypt 'was conquered during the reign of Khayan' (no year; 'Khyan 10+ years') while the Kamose page has Thebes holding Upper Egypt to Elephantine: not drawn. The Fifteenth Dynasty page gives Apophis c. 1590?-1550 and Khamudi c. 1550-1540, so the last king's years run a decade past the dynasty's own end c. 1550; the Second Intermediate Period page dates the 16th Dynasty c. 1650-1580.
No Hyksos tribute from Thebes is on any page opened (the 17th Dynasty page: 'mostly peaceful relationships with the Nubians and Hyksos'); the Hyksos as suzerain of the 16th (von Beckerath, Helck) is a scholarly view, not drawn. No dossier exists for fourteenth-dynasty-of-egypt (predecessor). The ruler strip is omitted: the table has only Salitis (19 years), Khyan (10+), Apophis (c. 1590?-1550) and Khamudi dated.
